intro: Across 13 articles published between 13 April 2026 and 10 October 2026, ZCyberNews tracked ShinyHunters and the exploitation of CVE-2026-35273. Coverage spanned education, government, law enforcement, technology, and consumer services, with activity observed across North America, the United States, Canada, Florida, and globally. The severity mix comprised 10 high-severity items and one critical item. This archive collects that reporting on ShinyHunters and CVE-2026-35273 as it developed over the period.
